why: The 2026-08-03 compression pass deleted the Anti-patterns block from every reviewer agent and rewrote 'Zero Issues is a valid outcome' into 'Zero Issues is a valid outcome - and a finding invented to look thorough costs a human round-trip the same as a real one', plus 167 words out of requesting-code-review. By word count those agent cuts are trivial (-1, -25, -7); by direction they all push toward PRECISION, and the surviving 'do not withhold, do not be conservative' line now sits beside two new sentences arguing the other way. Anthropic's guidance is that an instruction to be conservative is followed literally and lowers recall, so this case measures both sides at once. The planted defect is this repo's own recurring class: a guard applied to one path and not its sibling. apply_refund checks the outstanding balance; apply_refunds validates positivity and silently skips the balance check, so apply_refunds(Order(100), [500]) refunds 500 against a 100 order. The committed suite passes. The decoy is label_for, which looks like an off-by-one and is correct and range-checked. Grading reads the JSON index the prompt asks for, NOT the prose: an earlier draft regex-matched review.md and was polarity-blind, scoring "label_for's bounds check is correct -- no off-by-one" as a false positive in 3 of 5 pilot runs. A regex cannot tell an accusation from an exoneration. An earlier defect (a per-call cap with no running total) was also replaced: both arms found it 5/5, so it had no headroom to measure a recall change in either direction.
prompt:
Review the change on this branch: git diff HEAD~1. Write the finished review to ./review.md at the repo root — that file is the deliverable. For every issue, name the function and say concretely what input or sequence of calls makes it go wrong.

End review.md with one fenced ```json block holding an index of the issues you are reporting — a JSON array of objects, each with "symbol" (the function name), "severity" (critical, important, or minor), and "issue" (one sentence). Use an empty array if you are reporting nothing. The prose above it is the review; the block is its index.
